answer: The delta I would price into every new account is Assigned archivist licence with archivists society attestation: a licence the society renews after archive audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a licence the society renews after archive audits is bound to a single identity — the signal is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the vault for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
